subject.summary: Approximate reconstruction of the long four-storey ochre facade on the left of the supplied Stortorget photograph. Address not substantiated. Hidden ground level, roof and rear are inferred. Native hologram palette is not photorealistic plaster or terracotta.

sources.title: Human request to reconstruct the photo-left yellow range; no surveyed dimensions supplied

facts.value: Visible in reference: long oblique yellow facade, repeated upper window rows, continuous cornice, roof dormers and chimney group. Left image edge crops the range and market stalls obscure street level.
facts.note: Photo observation only; nine modeled upper bays are not a verified full-building count, and the full rear/footprint is not shown.

facts.value: Existing 27 m width, 18.7 m eave, 23 m ridge, 10 m depth, full range extent and hidden or occluded returns/details are agent/supervisor estimates.
facts.note: No exact-target published metric retrieved. Human assignment supplied a subject, not these dimensions.

facts.value: Stortorgskällaren describes itself as on Stortorget's south side and gives Stortorget 7 as its address.
facts.note: Documented non-metric statement; not a verified measurement. Positional/operator context only: does not establish that the entire photo-left range is one property, nor verify its bay/storey counts, age or color.
